versions.changelog:
Initial release of ClawPump skill — launch Solana tokens gasless, swap tokens, explore arbitrage, and track agent earnings via the ClawPump API.

- Supports gasless token launches on Solana with 65% trading fee earnings.
- Enables token swaps using Jupiter aggregator endpoints.
- Provides cross-DEX arbitrage scanning and transaction bundle building.
- Allows image uploads for custom token branding.
- Includes endpoints for checking agent earnings, leaderboard stats, and domain search.
- Clear API references and workflow examples included.
